protocol.binary: Same release binary and geometry. Independent off database copy removes the four room tables, selecting the existing no-room-tables full-render fallback. Automated shots intentionally ignore interactive preferences.
protocol.surface: Native Wayland floating window; screenshot dimensions asserted; benchmark disables vsync
protocol.profile: Separate two-sided instrumented run, excluded from timing medians
protocol.acceptance: No timeout or pending/failed work; correct camera; renderer proofs; off drawn=listed

limitations: One stationary Mercer house view per layer on Ryzen 5 1600 / GTX 1660, Vulkan, native Wayland, 1400x900.
Off control uses missing room tables. Interactive preference behavior is verified separately by tests.
Separate instrumented profiles are excluded from all timing summaries.
Render-thread graph/present interval dominates; native driver stacks were not sampled. GPU pass and CPU phase times overlap and are not added.
No local occluder work, native-game performance comparison, cold-load timing, continuous flight, or other renderer backend is included.
